title: iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with U2
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
**Exclusive Preview Of New Music From Band’s Forthcoming Album, Carnaval De Luz**


**Streaming LIVE on TikTok November 11**


*The event will also broadcast on iHeartRadio Classic Rock stations*


**WHAT:** **“iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with U2,”** to exclusively preview new music from the band’s forthcoming 16th studio album, Carnaval De Luz, set to be released on November 13. The event will stream LIVE on TikTok, broadcast on iHeartRadio Classic Rock stations, select Alternative stations and be available on the Classic Rock station online and on the[iHeartRadio app](https://www.iheart.com/live/classic-rock-4426/) on November 11 at 6 p.m. PT. Fans can register to watch the live event on TikTok[here](https://www.tiktok.com/@u2/video/7706171906847886595?lang=en) .


**WHO:** During the hour-long event, U2 will give an exclusive first listen of songs from the new album and share the stories and creative process behind the music. Fans can engage in real-time using TikTok features including polls, custom designed ‘like’ icons, and more that will be integrated throughout the session. Additionally, fans can visit iHeartRadio’s Classic Rock station online or on the[iHeartRadio app](https://www.iheart.com/live/classic-rock-4426/) and use the talkback feature to share their questions with U2 ahead of the show on November 11.


**WHEN:** Wednesday, November 11 at 6 p.m. PT


**WHERE:** Fans can tune in live via[@TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok?lang=en) ,[@iHeartRadio](https://www.tiktok.com/@iheartradio) and[@U2](https://www.tiktok.com/@u2?lang=en) accounts. Additionally the event will broadcast on iHeartRadio Classic Rock stations, select Alternative stations and be available on the Classic Rock station online and on the[iHeartRadio app](https://www.iheart.com/live/classic-rock-4426/) on November 11 at 6 p.m. PT.


*Support for the iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with U2 sponsored by Interscope Records*
